text.p: These were the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's news report on Tuesday at noon. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Algirdas Brazauskas will break his official visit to France and wgo to Madrid to attend the NATO summit.
- Several young Lithuanians organised a rally in front of the palace were the leaders of NATO gathered in Madrid urging them to accept Lithuania during the first stage of the alliance's expansion.
- Polish urban planning minister Barbara Brida offered her help in consulting Lithuania on credit policy to the construction sector.
